posts.title: Multithreaded JavaScript
posts.description: Over the last few weeks I haven't been able to stop thinking about multithreaded JavaScript. It all started with me seeing Jarred Sumner's PR adding shared-memory threads to JavaScriptCore in Bun's fork of WebKit. posts.title: Revival
posts.description: Like a phoenix rising from the ashes, my old blog is back, rebuilt with the help of Claude Code. The blog went offline after Emil passed away. 😢 To bring it back, I recovered the old posts by crawling the Internet Archive . Then I had Claude build a new site with Eleventy , which my dear friend Alex Russell has always spoken highly of. After a 12-year hiatus, maybe this will get me writing again.

posts.title: Traceur on JavaScript Jabber
posts.description: Last week the interview with me on JavaScript Jabber went live . The interview is a about Traceur but we also ended up talking quite a bit about ES6.
